aspect.description: The product aspect evaluated (e.g., sound_quality, battery_life, build_quality, comfort, price, connectivity, software)
aspect.title: Aspect

sentiment.description: Sentiment towards this specific aspect: Positive, Negative, or Neutral

evidence.description: Direct quote or snippet from the review supporting this aspect judgment
evidence.title: Evidence

review_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer review
review_id.title: Review Id

overall_sentiment.description: Overall review sentiment: Positive, Negative, or Neutral

aspects.description: List of aspect-level sentiment extractions with evidence snippets
aspects.title: Aspects

complaint_categories.description: Multi-label classification of complaints matching canonical complaint categories
complaint_categories.title: Complaint Categories

summary_takeaway.description: Concise 1-2 sentence core takeaway summarizing the review
summary_takeaway.title: Summary Takeaway

is_repaired.description: Flag indicating whether this record had to be auto-repaired from malformed LLM output
is_repaired.title: Is Repaired

repair_log.description: Log of transformations applied to repair malformed input
repair_log.title: Repair Log
